thread:
mike: heads-up — main turned red after the merge from feature/runner-upgrade. CI failing on pre-commit/typecheck and rustfmt. can someone quick-look?

ci-bot: build: failed • job=typecheck-py • exit=1
ci-bot: see: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/98765

mike: common breakage looks like lint/typecheck combo. pyright errors + rustfmt complaining about trailing comma positions.

anya: I pulled the logs — pyright shows mismatched import types in common/typing.py, but that file hasn't changed in weeks. suspect toolchain change.

leo: runner upgrade went out yesterday (infra) that bumped pre-commit + ruff + rustfmt via action. devops-bot should have the deploy note.

devops-bot: action: runner-images:update deployed at 2024-09-25T02:14:00Z • changed: pre-commit 2.22 -> 2.24, ruff 0.0.12 -> 0.1.0, rustfmt 1.6.1 -> 1.6.2

sara: if it's tool upgrades, we should bisect by the runner commit. I can do a quick local reproduce: run `pre-commit run --all-files` and `cargo fmt -- --check` in the repo.

mike: can you try and paste the exact failing output? want to decide revert vs pin.

sara: repro output: ```
+ pre-commit: running ruff................................................Failed
+ ruff version: 0.1.0
+ error: W293 blank line contains whitespace in common/typing.py:42
+ pyright: error: Expression of type 'None' cannot be assigned to parameter of type 'int' in utils/seq.py:17
+ cargo fmt: `error: src/lib.rs: line 200: trailing comma placement differs`
```

anya: interesting — ruff now flags whitespace on a blank line that used to be ignored. pyright complaining about None -> int looks like stricter type inference from updated typeshed or pyright bump.

leo: quickest mitigation: pin pre-commit hooks to previous versions in `.pre-commit-config.yaml` (ruff: 0.0.12, pyright/or whatever hook uses it). or revert the runner image until we pick a plan.

mike: I'm on-call, can't do a full rollout revert. can someone do a bisect to identify which runner change caused the failures? maybe it's just ruff.

anya: starting bisect now: I'll re-run CI locally by checking out main at commit before runner-upgrade and then at current. will report back.

(15m later)

anya: bisect result: the pre-commit change in our runner image (commit id e3a4f2) bumped ruff -> 0.1.0 and that alone reproduces the W293. pyright stricter errors came from pyright update in the same image. so two separate failures collapsed into one CI red.

mike: nice find. what's lowest-effort fix? pin hooks or silence rules?

leo: we should pin ruff in `.pre-commit-config.yaml` to 0.0.12 for now and open a follow-up to adopt 0.1.0 with autofix PRs. For pyright, we can add a typed-ignore or adjust the function signature where appropriate.

sara: I opened PR #2345 that pins ruff & pre-commit to previous versions and fixes the single failing blank-line whitespace via tiny whitespace delete. also added a pyright narrow type guard in utils/seq.py to avoid the None->int. https://git.internal/r/2345

mike: thanks — will queue CI rerun. @ci-bot can you re-run the failing jobs on that PR? :pray: 

ci-bot: rerun requested for PR #2345 • jobs: typecheck-py, format-rust • triggered by sara

(5m later)

ci-bot: build: success • PR #2345 • jobs: typecheck-py ✅ format-rust ✅

mike: merging now. follow-ups: (1) track upgrading ruff/pyright in a dedicated PR with autofix/lint updates, (2) add a note to the runner image upgrade playbook to call out major lint/type tool bumps.

leo: I'll own the runner playbook note.

anya: I'll open the upgrade plan for ruff/pyright with a small set of autofix commits and a smoke test.

mike: perfect. thanks all. :thumbsup: 

sara: cc @product if anyone sees any customer-facing impact (none observed).

mike: none so far, just CI noise. closing the loop.
